records.title: A Main Push Hold with Arc Rose and Shear
records.description: On defense, prepare the A Main push using the Arc Rose and Shear setup shown in the clip. The creator demonstrates three hold positions: behind the boxes, back site by the door, or on site. Use the original clip for the exact utility placement and flash timing; those details are not specified in the text description.

source.author: AirtightRiver41
source.evidence: Tracker identifies this as a Vyse Summit defense clip titled 'A set up'. The creator says it is a basic setup for an A Main push and lists the three hold positions (behind boxes, backsite by the door, or on site). The embedded 32-second clip was played and visually reviewed through the Arc Rose and wall utility views. Summit is in the current Competitive pool; Riot patch 13.08 lists Corrode as the map receiving geometry updates, not Summit. Source reviewed; not tested in a live match.
source.rightsBasis: No video, image, thumbnail or screenshot copied or rehosted. The creator's Tracker clip remains the linked original.
